title: Rest where attachment cannot rule
summary: Peace begins when refuge matters more than possession or praise. Seek sanctuary before possession writes the mood.
takeaway: Seek sanctuary before possession writes the mood.
lifeApplication: When praise, slander, or comparison moves you, step toward the Lord's sanctuary before attachment gets to narrate the moment.
